howto.title: How to play
howto.lead: One move explains it faster than a paragraph. Place a shard anywhere in the kiln.
howto.step.returned: The shape that was already around it has come back to your hand.
howto.step.empty: Nothing was around it, so what comes back is a plain block.
howto.step.hot: Go without clearing and the heat rises: each shard returns one square bigger.
howto.step.cleared: A line filled and the gold ran through. The heat drops, and you start from one square again.
howto.step.stuck: Nothing fits any more. That is how a game ends.
howto.luck: There is no luck in what you are dealt. The only randomness is the opening board. When it goes wrong, it was not a bad draw — it was the move you made a moment ago.
